description: This file defines a service class 'SlotsInputService_2024_09_04' for transforming slot query inputs, handling event type retrieval, and adjusting time parameters within a scheduling system. It interacts with various repositories to fetch event types, users, organizations, and teams, and provides methods for query transformation with routing considerations.

classes.name: SlotsInputService_2024_09_04
classes.description: Service class for transforming slot input queries, retrieving event types, and adjusting time parameters, with dependencies on repositories for users, organizations, teams, and event types.

methods.name: transformGetSlotsQuery
methods.description: Transforms input query into internal format, fetching event type and adjusting times.

methods.name: transformRoutingGetSlotsQuery
methods.description: Transforms routing input query into internal format, including routing-specific parameters.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Retrieves event type based on input type, using different repositories.

methods.name: getEventTypeUser
methods.description: Fetches user event type, considering organization context.

methods.name: getEventTypeTeam
methods.description: Fetches team event type, considering organization context.

methods.name: adjustStartTime
methods.description: Adjusts start time to ISO format, setting to start of day if time is midnight.

methods.name: adjustEndTime
methods.description: Adjusts end time to ISO format, setting to end of day if time is midnight.
